areaCards.title: Where It Is
areaCards.body: **Peenya Industrial Area** is Bangalore's original industrial estate, on **Tumkur Road (NH-48)** in the city's north-west, and one of the largest in the country. Engineering, machine tool, electrical, packaging and garment units sit side by side, and the **Green Line metro** runs straight into the city. **Huskur Road** runs off Tumkur Road towards Makali, and **Kachohalli** and **Machohalli** sit off Magadi Road near Kadabagere Cross. Further out on the highway are **Makali**, **Nelamangala** and **Dobbaspet**.

areaCards.title: Who It Suits
areaCards.body: Peenya suits **suppliers and ancillary units** that need to sit next to its manufacturing base, **small industrial users** looking for a **shed or factory space** inside the city, and **distributors** who want quick access into Bangalore with a road straight onto the Mumbai highway. Units here range from **small sheds and RCC units** to **large pre-engineered buildings**. Tell us your **size, budget and use**, and we'll shortlist across all of them.

rentGuide.intro: Rent in Peenya depends on the building, its age and how close it sits to the city. The table below shows asking rents on our live Peenya listings, and for Makali and Nelamangala next door.
rentGuide.description: The pre-engineered buildings along Tumkur Road offer the clear height and docks for distribution. The RCC stock inside the estate is lower and suits storage, kitting and light assembly next to the supplier base. Confirm floor loading on the older buildings before you plan racking.
